description: Retrieval evaluation queries for an autonomous SEO agent over the Alpinaria OKF bundle (+ shared playbook). Graded relevance: 2 = must appear, 1 = acceptable. distractors are near-duplicates that should rank BELOW the grade-2 concept (stale snapshot, wrong intent, wrong language, deprecated page). Queries marked added: wp0 were written from the bundle text before any search run (pre-registered). split is the seeded 70/30 dev/heldout assignment stratified by category x lang (test/fixtures/retrieval/assign-split.js); tune only on dev. sectionAnchor marks queries whose answer lives in one section of one concept (WP3a). family groups near-paraphrases: answerable queries outside the exact category that share the same primary grade-2 concept carry its bundle/id as family, and a family never spans both splits (see lib/split.js).

split.unit: paraphrase family (queries sharing `family`) or single query; a family never spans both splits

categories.nl-task: Natural-language task sentence, as the agent would phrase a question mid-task
categories.mixed-lang: Query mixing Italian and English terms
categories.exact: Exact-string lookup: SKU, URL path, brand/competitor term, technical token
categories.morph: Morphological variant of indexed words (singular/plural, noun/verb)
categories.accent: Accent variant: query without the accent the text has (or control with accent)
categories.synonym: Paraphrase using synonyms that do not occur in the relevant text
categories.freshness: Fresh/verified concept expected above a stale or superseded twin
categories.disambig: Near-duplicate disambiguation by intent or language
categories.playbook: Expected concept lives in the shared playbook bundle (project mode only)
categories.no-answer: Plausible agent question with no relevant concept; the system should return nothing or score low
